decision_summary: QIF v0.6.37 is approved for release with illustrative-evidence and anti-ranking limitations explicit.
rationale: Schema, example, verifier, 34 new negative fixtures, plain-language documentation, roadmap, and runtime evidence align; original judgments and dissent are preserved, adjudication is traceable, and all structural tests pass.
recommendation: Commit, tag, push, and publish v0.6.37; then begin v0.6.38 Route Policy Drift and Revalidation.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, operators, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can inspect who disagreed, why, on what evidence, how adjudication changed action, and what remains uncertain.
